<div id="_overview_4"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc48">11.1.  Overview</h2><p id="_e1c92bf6-8a6d-f0b7-6aea-699246a22948">This requirement class specifies how to retrieve a job list from the API.</p>
<span id="rc_job-list"></span><!-- requirements-class --></div>
<div id="_operation_9"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc49">11.2.  Operation</h2><div id="_job_list"><h3 class="published-heading">11.2.1.  Job list</h3><span id="req_job-list_job-list-op"></span><!-- requirement: job-list/job-list-op -->

<div id="_response_8"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc50">11.3.  Response</h2><span id="req_core_process-list-success"></span><!-- requirement: job-list/job-list-success -->
<pre class="prettyprint" id="_b97c9307-5249-d154-d784-d894778c8edd">type: object<br/>required:<br/>  - jobs<br/>  - links<br/>properties:<br/>  jobs:<br/>    type: array<br/>    items:<br/>      $ref: "statusInfo.yaml"<br/>  links:<br/>    type: array<br/>    items:<br/>      $ref: "link.yaml"</pre><p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Figure 27 — Schema for the job list</p>
<div class="Note" id="_68a2319b-5816-9b49-d41f-cd0e823ac81f"><p><span class="note_label">NOTE</span>  This schema can also be obtained from <a href="http://schemas.opengis.net/ogcapi/processes/part1/1.0/openapi/schemas/jobList.yaml"><tt>jobList.yaml</tt></a>.</p></div>
<p id="_f32ea2d7-4518-b388-4829-e3d044cd4066">(see also: <a href="#schema-statusInfo">statusInfo.yaml</a>, <a href="#link-schema">link.yaml</a>)</p>
<p id="_411d9476-d7a2-1793-5718-9dd771f0be08">The schema defines an array of <a href="#schema-statusInfo">status info elements</a> and includes a links section for navigation links within the API.</p>
<p id="_8a76ea3f-9727-a63c-da13-e7a2fc97c5eb">The number of jobs returned depends on the server and the parameter <tt>limit.</tt></p>
<p id="_6a4c76f0-fd0d-7916-0c62-83f1cfaac4ce">See the discussion about the <tt>limit</tt> parameter in the <a href="#sc_limit_parameter">Limit parameter</a> section.</p>
<span id="req_job-list_links"></span><!-- requirement: job-list/links -->
<p id="_4f6dd9f8-7982-296b-0780-c4608f88e2d4">See the discussion about the <tt>next</tt> links in the <a href="#next-link-discussion">Limit parameter</a> section.</p>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_job-list_next-1" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 21</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/job-list/next-1</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_2887b2f4-1189-25ee-cd3f-7f7c956879b3">A <tt>200</tt>-response SHOULD include a link to the next page (relation: <tt>next</tt>) of jobs, if more jobs have been selected than returned in the response.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_job-list_next-2" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 22</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/job-list/next-2</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_939e1795-d69a-8dbf-76ba-ce19535f8985">Dereferencing a next page link (relation: <tt>next</tt>) SHOULD return additional jobs from the set of selected jobs that have not yet been returned.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<table class="recommend" id="rec_job-list_next-3" style="border-collapse:collapse;border-spacing:0;"><thead><tr><th class="recommend" colspan="2" scope="colgroup" style="vertical-align:top;"><p class="RecommendationTitle">Recommendation 23</p></th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="recommend" colspan="2" style="vertical-align:top;"><p>/rec/job-list/next-3</p></td></tr><tr><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">A</td><td class="recommend" style="vertical-align:top;">
<p id="_8880aa08-9382-0115-ed43-ce6b243f0822">The number of jobs in a response to dereferencing a next page link (relation: <tt>next</tt>) SHOULD follow the same rules as for the response to the original query and again include a next page link (relation: <tt>next</tt>), if there are more jobs in the selection that have not yet been returned.</p>
</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p id="_e3e7e1d2-2642-d7c6-4bbd-26f97b5c93aa">See the discussion about the <tt>prev</tt> link in the  <a href="#prev-link-discussion">Limit parameter</a> section.</p>
<span id="per_job-list_prev"></span><!-- permission: job-list/prev -->
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  1 — A HTTP GET request for retrieving a list of jobs encoded as JSON.</p><div class="example" id="_29b2a7ee-0669-a0c7-35e1-a50e2d053329"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_4ce94390-e686-aa2c-90f2-3b4fc82c1d38">http://processing.example.org/jobs</pre>
</div>
<p class="SourceTitle" style="text-align:center;">Example  2 — A job list encoded as JSON.</p><div class="example" id="_907a72be-bb29-39a1-c914-6d9e0e93da70"><pre class="prettyprint" id="_cc6ef24a-70fc-2ab2-1db3-9a2e35664089">{<br/>  "jobs": [<br/>    {<br/>      "processID": "Voronoi",<br/>      "jobID": "8ca109b4-3b86-4a9c-a284-a6d50f91019e",<br/>      "status": "running",<br/>      "message": "Perform step 1/2",<br/>      "progress": 50,<br/>      "links": [<br/>        {<br/>          "href": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs/8ca109b4-3b86-4a9c-a284-a6d50f91019e",<br/>          "rel": "status",<br/>          "type": "application/json",<br/>          "hreflang": "en",<br/>          "title": "Job status"<br/>        }<br/>      ]<br/>    },<br/>    {<br/>      "processID": "EchoProcess",<br/>      "jobID": "0cf773a5-282a-4e23-96cc-f5dab18123e5",<br/>      "status": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs/0cf773a5-282a-4e23-96cc-f5dab18123e5",<br/>          "rel": "status",<br/>          "type": "application/json",<br/>          "hreflang": "en",<br/>          "title": "Job status"<br/>        },<br/>        {<br/>          "href": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs/0cf773a5-282a-4e23-96cc-f5dab18123e5/results",<br/>          "rel": },<br/>    {<br/>      "processID": "EchoProcess",<br/>      "jobID": "63aadd9c-c0e5-4a7f-80f0-228dbb158f09",<br/>      "status": "failed",<br/>      "message": "EchoProcess job failed",<br/>      "progress": 100,<br/>      "links": [<br/>        {<br/>          "href": "http://processing.example.org/oapi-p/jobs/63aadd9c-c0e5-4a7f-80f0-228dbb158f09",<br/>          "rel": "status",<br/> <div id="_error_situations_9"><h2 class="published-heading" id="toc51">11.4.  Error situations</h2><p id="_e70d2e3c-60d6-4d7d-1cf0-3127a5f94bb7">See <a href="#http_status_codes">Clause 7.5.1</a> for general guidance.</p>
<p id="_e50abe11-430c-70ce-026b-c7581d6c1682">If the process with the specified identifier does not exist on the server, the status code of the response SHALL be <tt>404</tt> (see <a href="#req_core_process-exception-no-such-process">Clause 7.10.3, Requirement 15</a>).</p></div>
</div>
